rules: Architecture formulas may be justified by project requirements and code evidence; they do not need a paper pretending to validate a local data structure.
A paper supports only the construct, population, task and outcome it actually studied.
Platform disclosures support only the disclosed mechanism; absent weights, ranking rules or causal effects remain unknown.
Internal samples describe this collected set only; without denominators or controls they are not platform or outcome laws.
Evidence and handlers are inherited only when the canonical semantic fingerprint matches; changing the AST, variables, prompt-facing explanation or evidence status requires review.
